system.description: When you pick up a package, spend 1 Fabula Point to declare it rare equipment you can equip, chosen by the GM, worth up to ((level + SL) × 50) zenit. Only you may equip it; one package at a time; the loan ends on delivery. Never a hoplosphere or sphere-bearing gear.
